orgFilesTab.intro: On each server, Provisa keeps your organization's caches, conversions, replicas and large results in your organization's own folder. Turn on encryption to keep them encrypted under a key your organization holds.
orgFilesTab.referenceHelp: The key's name in your organization's secrets vault, written ${secret:NAME}. Provisa stores only this reference, never the key.
orgFilesTab.referenceWrong: Write the key's name as ${secret:NAME}, not the key itself.
orgFilesTab.generatedHelp: Shown once. Copy it into your organization's secrets vault now, then set the key reference.
orgFilesTab.warn1: Provisa cannot recover this key, and nobody at Provisa can see or reset it.
orgFilesTab.warn2: Store it in your organization's secrets vault now; it will not be shown again.
orgFilesTab.warn3: Keep a second copy in a separate secure location under your own control.
orgFilesTab.warn4: Limit who can read it, and never send it by email, chat or ticket.
orgFilesTab.warn5: If it is lost, the files cannot be opened until you set a new key, and setting one resets the encrypted files.
orgFilesTab.warn6: To rotate it, generate a new key, store it in your vault, and update the reference.
orgFilesTab.saved: Saved. Each server applies it when it next starts work for this organization.
